name: termux-tutorial
description: A three-part interactive Termux course series — one repository, one GitHub Pages site, one URL.
author: dnoice
//: THIS IS AN ORCHESTRATOR, NOT A WORKSPACE. It has no dependencies of its
own and deliberately does NOT declare npm workspaces: hoisting a shared
node_modules would put the four projects' Astro/Vite/xterm resolutions in
one tree, and the xterm SSR alias in each course resolves through Node's
own resolver (createRequire) precisely because that resolution is load-
bearing. Each project keeps its own node_modules and its own lockfile;
these scripts just stop you having to visit four directories to use them.
Every script reads the four-project topology from scripts/projects.mjs, so
adding a course is one edit there rather than four edits spread across
this file, deploy.yml, and the README.
engines.node tracks what Astro 7 actually requires (its own package.json
declares >=22.12.0). It previously said >=20, which no project here can
satisfy: CI pins Node 22 so CI was fine, but this file is the only Node
statement a local contributor ever sees, and it permitted a version Astro
refuses. If Astro's floor moves, move this with it.
